schema_ref: No declared schema; see docs/tier3_project_instantiation/source_materials/sources.json for the shape rationale. runner/dev_graph/builder.py asks only for a non-empty source_id and, if present, a string text.
artifact_purpose: The Tier 3 source index of the MSCA-DN pre-evaluation graph root. Empty at PE-01. PE-03 writes one source per page of the sanitised copy, SRC-DN-P01 to SRC-DN-P84, each holding that page's extracted text, so a verified_span resolves to a page and an offset.
